Senegal have been confirmed as Africa Cup of Nations winners after succeeding with an appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), ten months after they beat Morocco in Rabat. The ruling follows a controversial final in which Senegal initially won 1-0 after extra time, only for the result to be overturned following an appeal by the Moroccan Football Federation. Two months after the final, the Confederation of African Football’s (CAF) appeal board ruled that Senegal had forfeited the match because their players had walked off the pitch in protest. Morocco were subsequently awarded a 3-0 victory and the title. That decision was based on Articles 82 and 84 of the AFCON regulations, which state that leaving the pitch constitutes a forfeit. Despite CAF stripping Senegal of the title, they took the case to CAS and argued that FIFA laws state the referee’s decision is final. Therefore, because the officials did not enforce the competition regulations at the time, Senegal believed there were no grounds to overturn the result. #afcon #senegal #morocco #soccer #news

Four days in Marrakech, Morocco and I already can't wait to go back! 🇲🇦✨ If you’re planning your first trip to Morocco, Marrakech is the perfect place to dive into the country’s rich culture, incredible food, and beautiful architecture. Between getting lost in the medina, learning to cook traditional Moroccan dishes, and enjoying a little luxury in the Agafay Desert, we packed SO much into four days! One thing I loved most about Marrakech was how every day felt completely different. You can spend one morning exploring centuries of history and the next relaxing poolside with views of the Atlas Mountains. And the hospitality? Some of the best I’ve experienced. 🥹 My biggest recommendation is to leave some room in your Marrakech itinerary to wander, shop, and enjoy the city without rushing from one attraction to the next. 📌 Save this 4-day Marrakech itinerary for your Morocco vacation, and tell me: Would you rather spend a day exploring the souks or relaxing in the Agafay Desert? #MarrakechMorocco #MarrakechItinerary #MoroccoTravel #VisitMarrakech #blacktravelblogger things to do in Marrakech, Marrakech itinerary

5 things to know before going to Morocco👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Always carry cash. Morocco is still very cash-based, especially in local shops, markets and smaller restaurants. 💵 2️⃣ Be a responsible tourist. Think twice before paying for animal encounters in Marrakech, particularly the monkeys and snakes in Jemaa el-Fnaa. 🐒 3️⃣ Explore beyond Marrakech. Some of Morocco’s best experiences are outside the city, so make time for places like Chefchaouen, Volubilis and the Atlas Mountains. 🏜️ 4️⃣ Having mobile data when you land makes your arrival so much easier. I use Unpack for my travels. Download the app and use code "ALEX" for 20% off your first eSIM plan. (Link in bio)📱 5️⃣ If you’re visiting on a Friday, make sure you try traditional Moroccan couscous. Así debería verse tu viaje a Marruecos. 🇲🇦✨ Un país donde las ciudades imperiales, los paisajes del desierto y las tradiciones milenarias se encuentran para crear una experiencia inolvidable. 🕌 Comienza en Casablanca, frente a la impresionante Mezquita de Hassan II, y descubre Rabat, la elegante capital marroquí. Continúa hacia Fez, donde sus laberínticas calles, talleres de artesanos y famosas curtidurías te transportarán a otra época. Descubre también Mequinez, otra de las grandes ciudades imperiales del país. 🌿 Recorre los paisajes del Atlas pasando por Ifrán, conocida como la pequeña Suiza marroquí, y Midelt, antes de llegar a Erfoud y las puertas del Sáhara. Vive la magia del desierto, contempla sus dunas doradas y disfruta de una noche bajo las estrellas. 🐪 🏜️ Descubre los impresionantes paisajes de Tineghir, los valles de Kelaa M'Gouna y Ouarzazate, conocida como la puerta del desierto. Déjate sorprender por el ksar de Ait Ben Haddou, una espectacular ciudad fortificada de adobe declarada Patrimonio de la Humanidad. 🌺 Termina en Marrakech, entre los colores de sus zocos, los aromas de las especias, los jardines y el ambiente inconfundible de la plaza Jemaa el-Fna. #morocco #marruecos #travel #viajes
